notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone,[/p][p][/p][p][b]It's now official: early access for Bakery Cafe Simulator is set for July 8! 🎉[/b]

I can't wait to show you all the new features I've been working on, and that we'll be continuing to work on after this release! 

Here's a sneak preview of the new recipes and ingredients you'll find in the game when it is released in early access. Of course, many more will be added over the coming months.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45415750/96de2fdde4399ae44a221398af84390441101592.png"][/img]

[b]From July 8 and for one week, you'll be able to get Bakery Cafe Simulator for less than $10[/b] (almost half the price of an espresso in the game ) and enjoy all the new recipes, employee system, new furniture and much more! [/p]

notes.title: Content update - Steam fest
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone,
[/p][p]Yesterday was the start of Steam Fest, and I'm happy to announce that Bakery Cafe Simulator is part of it![/p][p][/p][p]To celebrate the news, we're pleased to offer you [b]an exclusive content update for the game's demo[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]You'll find a new beverage, the caramel latte, as well as two pieces of equipment that have been very much in demand by the community: a more efficient coffee maker allowing you to store up to 2L of coffee in advance, and a storage rack for your plates.[/p][p][/p][p][b][i]!! This content update is available exclusively on the demo and not on the prologue.[/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p]In parallel, the game's development is progressing well and I'll be happy to share the progress with you very soon.[/p][p][/p][p]Wishing you a good day and a great festival![/p][p]Cédric from Meerkatt Studio[/p]

notes.title: Demo Update #04
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

[h1]The forth patch of the demo is here, and here's what to expect in-game:[/h1]

[list]
[*] You can now pin the recipes on your HUD so you can read it while working on it
[*] Fixed a lot of issues, mostly with multiplayer
[*] Fixed issues with the customers not going in the queue after eating
[*] Customers now choose tables randomly
[*] Customers can now order both food & beverage
[*] Korean language as been added
[*] Made a custom lighting for low graphical settings so you don't get brightness issues
[/list]

Thanks again to everyone,
See you soon for the next patch

notes.title: Demo Update #03
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

[h2]The third patch of the demo is here, and here's what to expect in-game:[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]All-new box system - The aim is to overcome many of the problems of the previous system, such as unloading time (there are now fewer boxes) and the difficulty of accessing the contents of the boxes.[/b]
[*]A new options system (it doesn't change anything for you, except perhaps some keys to be reassigned)
[*]Small change in controls to accommodate the new cardboard system: R is now used by default to rotate objects and F is used to change modes. This allows you to keep the scroll wheel to navigate through the boxes.
[*]Reduced duration of interactions: the interactions to be held were long, which made the gameplay very rigid, especially when making recipes.
[*]More range on the interaction system
[*]Single-player game can be paused by clicking escape 🎉
[*]Fridge opening controls have been moved to the left click to harmonize door opening logic with other objects.
[*]Minor bug fixes
[/list]

[h2]Which will come in the next few days:[/h2]


[list]
[*]Translation of the game into all the languages available on the steam page (gradually).
[*]Dedicated cash register update to make it more satisfying and pleasant to use, and to resolve queuing bugs (I won't be able to do anything for players who actively decide to block the system by blocking customers)
[*]Dedicated customer update to make them more realistic and add granularity
[/list]

Thanks again to everyone,
See you soon for the next patch

notes.title: Demo Update #02
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Here we are at the second patch of the demo, here is the list of changes made :
[list]
[*][b]Updated money & experience gained: The system now takes into account the number of players in the game, and speeds up overall progress and money gain, especially when you're playing alone[/b]
[*]Small experience bar animation
[*]Widget notifying you that you have just gained a level and unlocked content
[*]Jazz music in your store to help you work in a good mood
[*]A redesign of the cash register to make it more user-friendly (this is not yet complete)
[*]More onboarding to help players understand how the various features work
[*]Pastry bowls can be emptied of their ingredients into the waste garbage can
[*] Fixing save issues
[/list]
I'm continuing to improve the game day by day based on all your feedback, and together we'll succeed in creating the game we all want to play 😍

Thank you all!

notes.title: Demo Update #01
notes.notes:
Hi guys,

A new patch has been released based on your feedback today, here are the notable changes to the demo:

[list]
[*]Adding Sprint
[*]Changed app's names and furnitures name to make easier to use
[*]Fixing some bug with multiplayer character initialization
[*]Fixing issues with the tray & Cup holder
[*]Removed truck horn 
[*]Created a new door
[*]Fixing issue with income calculation on the end of day recap widget
[*]Fixing multiple issues with the multiplayer mode
[/list]

[b]Due to the change in level design, the next time you launch the game you may see flying objects in the old counter and new door locations. Don't hesitate to use the edit menu (R) to move any objects that get stuck.[/b]

Next patch will be focus on Quality Of Life & A faster progression system that takes into account the number of players in the session. It will also be released this week.

In parallel, I'm still trying to figure out how to solve the many GPU crash problems encountered by some players. I'll get back to you as soon as it's fixed.

Wishing you a good week,
Cédric from Meerkatt Studio

notes.title: Demo is out now! What comes next?
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I'd like to thank you for the official release of our demo and for your warm welcome!

I know that many of you have been waiting for this game and have quite specific expectations of what it should look like. Even though I'm doing my utmost to offer you a quality game with content, there may still be some bugs or unresolved issues that I'm rushing to correct as we go along... During these first days of release, I've received several negative reviews on our demo's Steam page that I find a little harsh, even though I'm working on this game alone and doing my utmost to resolve any bugs encountered as quickly as possible...

Over the next few weeks, I'll be doing my utmost to improve the gaming experience and spread the word about the game!

See you soon,

Cédric from Meerkatt Studio

notes.title: The playtests continue!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Our playtest phase has been underway for several weeks now. First of all, I'd like to thank our wonderful community for participating in the playtest and for all the constructive feedback we've received! It warms our hearts and motivates us even more for what's to come.

On the subject of what's next, we wanted to clarify our objectives for the coming weeks: First, we're going to publish a content-oriented update on our playtest. This new version will address the in-game quality-of-life issues regularly raised by testers: cup storage, tray storage, cup unloading from trays, as well as the addition of a temperature mechanic to ensure that your coffees don't linger too long on the counter before being served to customers! 

This will be the last patch in our playtest (excluding bug fixes). At the same time, we're working hard on the demo, which will offer you a much more user-friendly experience, closer to the final one, with more content, more customization and clearer tutorial systems.

We'll be sure to keep you informed of the demo's release in due course, but it shouldn't be too much longer!

Thank you all again for your patience and your investment in our community.
If you'd like to be kept informed on a more regular basis of progress and help improve the game, don't hesitate to [url=https://discord.com/invite/s2hyk6mc8y]join our community on Discord[/url].

notes.title: Playtesting begins this week
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

As promised in my last message, it's now time to test the very first version of Bakery Cafe Simulator!

The version I'll be offering you initially will be very limited in terms of content, but it will allow us to make sure everything's working properly in preparation for the demo, which should be out next month with several hours of content to explore on your own or with friends!

Please keep in mind that this first version of the playtests does not reflect the quality of the final game, and may contain many bugs that I'll try to resolve as quickly as possible.

Would you like to help us build the best possible game during this phase? Come and chat with us on [url=https://discord.com/invite/s2hyk6mc8y]our Discord server[/url]!
